adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the save action. Looking at lines 32-38 of embeddable-host.js.es6: when categoryId is null/empty (user cleared the category chooser), the server-side code in embeddable_hosts_controller.rb line 24 sets it to uncategorized_category_id as a default. However, the client-side code at line 37 does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` which will set category to null (since categoryId is null/empty and findById(null) returns null). This creates an inconsistency where the server saved uncategorized but the client displays null until page reload.
